q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a uPVC window?
title: uPVC window carbon footprint per window
short: Weigh the uPVC profile, steel reinforcement and glass per window and multiply by supplier figures. Add cutting, welding, cleaning and glazing electricity, then divide the shop's energy by windows made and report per square metre.

ul: Galvanised steel reinforcement inside the profiles.
Hot plate welding and corner cleaning.

p: Report per square metre of window by type, because buyers compare openings of different sizes.

example.title: Worked example: uPVC window unit per window (one month)
lines: Plant total: 5,680 / 1,500 = 3.787 kg CO2 per window
Add profile, steel and glass for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
